description: A pool's lifecycle decides each candle once (audit M3, s5-v16): the walk starts at the first undecided candle, and only a marginal penetration on the last decided candle is carried to its confirmation. Found live 2026-09-18: DOGEUSDT M5 sweep written 471 periods late. Deterministic tests, so one battery run is a verdict. Run from backend/: uv run python -m tests.support.mutation_battery tests/mutations/lifecycle_decided_once.json The walk's start at the last decided candle is a shortcut, not the rule (the walk skips decided candles itself), so no mutation targets it: removing it cannot change an outcome.

mutations.name: a decided candle is judged in the walk
a marginal penetration on the last decided candle is dropped
the pass does not hand its decided candle to the lifecycle
